figmaCorrections.issue: The token definition file lists Text/Hint as #374151, but the resolved usage across table headers and pagination renders #6b7280. The token name maps to two different values depending on context, which is ambiguous for implementers.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Resolve Text/Hint to a single value (the rendered #6b7280) or split into two named tokens so the build can bind unambiguously.

figmaCorrections.element: Filter chips row (Frame 11) hidden in handoff
figmaCorrections.issue: The 'Default Chips' filter row (nodes 4226:40025-40029) is hidden=true with sizes 122/114 x 36 but no resolved fills/text. Implementers cannot build the filter-chip state from this frame.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Provide a visible, fully-specified variant of the filter chips state (fills, text styles, active/selected behavior) if filtering is a supported feature on this screen.

figmaCorrections.issue: The live build requires a per-row Delete action (financial years are CRUD records), but the Figma frame only specifies an 'Edit' action with no delete/destructive control or confirmation pattern.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Add a specified Delete row action (icon, color from Danger/Source #d64539, confirmation dialog) to the Figma frame so the build has an authoritative reference.

figmaCorrections.issue: Figma models column 2 as a generic 'Status' (Active/Inactive badge), but the domain reality is a single 'current financial year' selector (only one FY is current). A badge per row does not capture the single-select nature the live build implements as a checkbox.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Decide and document the intended interaction: if it is a single-select 'current year' control, design that control (radio/toggle/checkbox) in Figma; if it is a status display, keep the badge but clarify how status is set.
